description: This file defines classes related to handling requests within a plugin framework, including the Request class, performance monitoring classes, and JSON-RPC tracking. It includes request state management, service association, and optional performance statistics collection.

classes.name: Request
classes.description: Represents a web request, including its state, associated service, and whether it is a service call or JSONRPC call.

classes.name: PerformanceAdministrator
classes.description: Manages performance statistics collection and retrieval, including nested Statistics and DataSet classes.

classes.name: PerformanceAdministrator::Statistics
classes.description: Holds statistical data and provides methods to clear, add data, and retrieve statistics.

classes.name: PerformanceAdministrator::Statistics::DataSet
classes.description: Stores individual performance metrics such as deserialization, thread pool, execution, communication, serialization, and total times.

classes.name: PerformanceAdministrator::Statistics::Tuple
classes.description: Aggregates statistical measurements, providing minimum, maximum, average, and count.

classes.name: TrackingJSONRPC
classes.description: Tracks JSON-RPC message statistics, including input/output sizes, timing, and performance metrics.

methods.name: Request::ServiceCall
methods.description: Checks if the request was received over the service prefix path.

methods.name: Request::State
methods.description: Returns the current state of the request.

methods.name: Request::Service
methods.description: Returns a reference to the associated service proxy.

methods.name: Request::Service
methods.description: Sets the service error code, associated service, and whether it is a service call.

methods.name: PerformanceAdministrator::Statistics::Tuple::Measurement
methods.description: Updates the tuple with a new data point, adjusting min, max, and average.

methods.name: PerformanceAdministrator::Statistics::Add
methods.description: Adds a new DataSet to the statistics, updating min/max/avg.

methods.name: PerformanceAdministrator::Retrieve
methods.description: Retrieves statistics for a given package size.

methods.name: TrackingJSONRPC::In
methods.description: Records input data size and timing.

methods.name: TrackingJSONRPC::Out
methods.description: Records output data size and timing.

methods.name: TrackingJSONRPC::Acquire
methods.description: Marks the start of a request processing.

methods.name: TrackingJSONRPC::Relinquish
methods.description: Marks the end of a request processing and stores performance data.
